title: Pokeblocks unofficial
description: Unofficial NeoForge build of Pokeblocks for Minecraft 1.21.1
body:
# Pokeblocks NeoForge Unofficial

Bring more collectible decorations to your world ! This is an unofficial NeoForge build of Pokeblocks for Minecraft `1.21.1`.

This mod adds a large collection of placeable Pokedolls, oversized gigantic variants, themed decorations, figurines, and collectible items for players who want to decorate bases, shops, spawn areas, gyms, or Cobblemon-style servers.

## Features

- A large lineup of placeable Pokedolls.
- Regular, shiny, animated, and gigantic doll variants.
- Decorative blocks such as the Luvdisc Cushion, Magikarp Fishbowl, Applin Basket, Eiscue Head, and Pokemon Trophy.
- Figurines and small collectible items for display or server rewards.
- Poke Block decorations for Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle variants.
- Pokedolls can appear in supported vanilla chest loot tables.
- English and French language support.
- Compatible with current [CobbledGacha v.3](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledgacha) for Minecraft `1.21.1` on NeoForge

## Good for

- Cobblemon-themed worlds and servers.
- Decorative reward crates, builds, and event areas.
- Player shops, museums, collection rooms, and themed bases.
- Anywhere you want pokemon style plushies i guess. 

## Compatibility

- Minecraft `1.21.1`
- NeoForge `21.1.200+`
- GeckoLib `4.8.4` or newer

## Credits and License

This is an unofficial NeoForge redistribution/port of Pokeblocks. Original mod credit goes to **MrShawn**. Apart from the NeoForge port, the only changes are french translations and fixes described in the changelogs.
